points.text: ECI let voters marked **ASDD** in 7 SIR States/UTs resubmit their enumeration form (not Form 6) to get re-included; follows a SC query on Oct 28.
Mustafabad Form-7 case: ERO sought an FIR against BJP BLA Nainwal after **36 of 37** deletion applications were found fabricated; Section 31 RP Act invoked.
Editorial: using voter ID+biometrics to verify welfare beneficiaries contradicts the **SC's May 27** Bihar-SIR ruling that ECI's citizenship enquiry is limited to electoral consequences alone.
Gauhati HC quashed the **NSA detention** of Assam activist Pranab Doley (anti-hotel protest near Kaziranga), freeing him after 118 days.
SC (CJI Surya Kant): cybercriminals have "no space in society"; digital-arrest complaints fell from **1,23,672** (2024) to **16,377** (H1 2026); e-Zero FIR works in 19 States.
SC declined to suspend **Tarun Tejpal**'s 10-year sentence in the 2013 Goa rape case but agreed to hear his appeal.
SC sought NewsClick/editor Prabir Purkayastha's response on ED's plea over a quashed money-laundering case alleging **₹9.59 crore** FDI violations.
SC issued a contempt notice to KPCC office-bearers over a social-media post against **Chief Justice of India** Surya Kant: "judicial independence is not a matter of political convenience."
Jharkhand HC quashed the cancellation of the **JSSC-CGL** exam, ordering reinstatement with continuous service for candidates selected under advt 10/2023.
NC chief Farooq Abdullah ruled out a party split after meeting 17 dissident MLAs; Speaker Birla accepted Ruhullah Mehdi's resignation (effective Nov 3).
Amit Shah set a "hat-trick" target of 65+ of Uttarakhand's 70 Assembly seats for the BJP.
SC clarified its **March 11, 2026** OBC creamy-layer judgment does not require retrospective revision of service allocations/seniority; CSE-2025 results stand.
CBSE's **2027** Class 10/12 boards begin **16 February** (Class 10 ends 9 March, Class 12 ends 9 April); 26.5 lakh Class 10 and 19.8 lakh Class 12 students registered.

Centre mandated weekly rice/paddy stock declarations under the **Essential Commodities Act, 1955**; let 5 southern States impose stock limits till Jan 31, 2027; doubled the OMSS e-auction target to 50 lakh tonnes.
SC called Delhi's vehicle/construction bans "old, tried and **failed tools**" for pollution, asking for a scientific alternative, as AQI crossed **400** and GRAP-III kicked in.

Ground report: the **Siang Upper Multipurpose Project** (11,000 MW) faces Adi community opposition; China's Medog dam on the Yarlung-Tsangpo cited to justify speeding it up; Article 371(h) referenced.
SC settled the **1966** Bhakra-Beas power dispute: Himachal Pradesh gets **11,973 million units** from Punjab/Haryana over 20 years, per 2011-fixed shares (HP 7.19%).
Sensex +2.17% to **81,028.02**, Nifty +2.01% to **25,030.35** (highest since **March 2**; Nifty's biggest weekly rally of 2026) even as Nasdaq-100 fell 6.36%; rupee hit a 6-month high of **93.89**/$.
Mumbai NCLT declared Videocon's **Venugopal Dhoot** "bankrupt" over a **₹12,668 crore** SBI default.
NPCI set up **NPCI Tech Solutions Ltd (NTSL)** for AI/blockchain/GCC services; Vishal Kanvaty named MD & CEO.
Govt approved 12 more **ECMS** projects, taking total investment commitment to **₹77,051 crore** (118 projects, ~30% above the original target).
Delhi Police arrested 3 contractors over the Chawri Bazar collapse under **BNS Section 105**; 4 workers remained missing on Day 2.

Op-ed: the Ken-Betwa project (96.7m dam) and two M.P. dams threaten **8,000 Adivasi families** across 22 villages; 2.3 million trees to be felled; FRA Section 4(5) rights not recognised before eviction.

Congress renewed its demand to scrap Agnipath, alleging a 2-lakh-soldier shortfall and over 40 Agniveer suicides, a day after the Cabinet clarifying **Agniveers** get a **2-year extension** after their **4-year tenure**.
Chennai TB nonprofit **REACH** won the **Tuberculosis (TB)** Kochon Prize 2026, the first Indian civil-society org to do so.
Brent crude fell **16%** this week after Iran opened the Strait of Hormuz for transit to a few countries including India, reviving US-Iran resolution hopes.
India-born Democratic Socialist **Nithya Raman** was elected Mayor of Los Angeles, beating incumbent Karen Bass 52%-48%.
Israel's Eisenkot expects the government-formation mandate from President Herzog on Sunday; Opposition partner Liberman lifted his ultra-Orthodox veto but still refuses an Israeli-Arab alliance.
The 13th **ICAPP** General Assembly (Seoul, 83 Asian parties) adopted the "Seoul Declaration" on non-interference and peaceful dispute settlement.
The US recorded **5,182** measles cases this year, the most since 1991, despite the disease being declared eliminated there in 2000.
Indian GM **V. Pranav** (20) won the FIDE World Junior Blitz Championship Open title in Al Ain, adding to his Junior Classical title.
**Mohammed Shami** retired from Tests with 229 wickets in 64 matches over 13 years; debuted vs West Indies at Eden Gardens on this date in 2013.
**Mitchell Starc** reached 460 Test wickets in 110 matches — the most by any left-arm pacer ever — passing Wasim Akram's 414 in the 2025-26 Ashes.
India won its first-ever aquatics medals at the Youth Olympics (Dakar): Dhinidhi Desinghu took bronze in both 100m and 200m freestyle; Tirthank Pegu bronze in 200m butterfly.
**Tanvi Patri** won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China.
